outcome: Latency period from PPROM to delivery
Oxidative stress markers (oxygen radical absorbance capacity, malondialdehyde (MDA), protein carbonyl, and interleukin-6)
cohort: The study included patients with singleton pregnancies and PPROM at earlier than 34 gestational weeks who were admitted to Chonnam National University, Gwangju, Korea, between February 2007 and December 2015.
finding: The study found no significant difference between the two antibiotic regimens in terms of latency period, neonatal outcomes, or oxidative stress markers, although the regimen with clarithromycin might offer a short-term benefit in prolonging pregnancy up to 48 hours.
